text: The Tupalhasa Field Office opened in 2024, and its budget code is ZY-7926-N, with access badge series TW-2110-D. Buthia Norven, Zonvor Dirnasor, Ragos Drosporel, and Krosso Velfosan are based there, along with the Donnoett Loom and the Lozeine Applied Research Lab. Gibasan Logistics delivers equipment to the Tupalhasa Field Office.
